purpose: Freeze the P-01 claim per CEO R279 P0 directive. Remove all overclaim language. State only what the simulator actually shows.
constitutional_basis: Article XXVIII — no silent semantic promotion. Article XXXI — self-correction creates memory artifact.
frozen_claim: Predictive isolation + redistribution improves shunt-failure trajectory relative to reactive redundancy (Arm B) and conventional single-path (Arm A) in the current model. However, it does NOT outperform predictive closed-loop modulation without isolation (Arm D) on time-to-failure, and under realistic sensor noise it performs dramatically worse than D. The isolation mechanism's only advantage is lower peak ICP under low-noise conditions.
what_we_do_NOT_claim: Prevents shunt failure — FALSE, system breaks at ~7.7h (C) or ~8.9h (D) under 2-segment progressive occlusion
Guarantees ICP safety — FALSE, peak ICP 22 mmHg exceeds 20 mmHg hard limit
Represents current standard of care — FALSE, 59 mmHg is the simulator's single-segment baseline, NOT a measured clinical benchmark
Provides 7-9x clinical benefit — FALSE, 7-9x is a model-vs-model comparison vs Arm A (weakest baseline), NOT clinical evidence
Outperforms existing predictive closed-loop approaches — FALSE, Arm D (our reproduction of US20210338992A1 + 2023 ML approach) outperforms C on time-to-failure
what_we_DO_claim: Multi-segment hardware + predictive control (C or D) outperforms single-path (A) and reactive redundancy (B) in the model
Reactive redundancy (B) is WORSE than single-path (A) — sudden isolation of dead segments causes harmful ICP transients
Prediction (C or D) extends time-to-failure ~6-7x vs A in the model (7.7-8.9h vs 1.3h)
The isolation mechanism (C vs D) does NOT add value on time-to-failure and is FRAGILE under sensor noise
The isolation mechanism (C vs D) provides lower peak ICP under low-noise conditions only (22 vs 30 mmHg)

R279_reassessment_of_value_proposition.original_V1_0_claim: Strict dual-invariant holds (prevents failure) — FALSIFIED in R277
R279_reassessment_of_value_proposition.R278_V1_1_claim: Prediction outperforms redundancy 7-9x — TRUE vs A/B, but MISLEADING because it implied clinical benefit and ignored stronger baselines
R279_reassessment_of_value_proposition.R279_V1_2_finding: Isolation mechanism does NOT outperform closed-loop modulation (D). P-01's original value proposition is NOT supported.
R279_reassessment_of_value_proposition.honest_assessment: P-01 has been falsified twice: (1) strict dual-invariant failed (R277), (2) isolation mechanism doesn't beat closed-loop modulation (R279). The package needs strategic reformulation.

path_1_drop_isolation.description: P-01 becomes 'predictive closed-loop multi-segment shunt controller' (Arm D). Drop the isolation mechanism entirely.
path_1_drop_isolation.value_proposition: Multi-segment hardware + predictive closed-loop valve modulation. Outperforms conventional single-path by ~7x on time-to-failure.
path_1_drop_isolation.differentiation_concern: Arm D is close to US20210338992A1 (closed-loop shunt with sensors + controller + valve). IP position needs careful assessment. Differentiation narrows to 'multi-segment hardware' + 'specific control law.'
path_1_drop_isolation.honest_label: INCREMENTAL over existing art. Weaker commercial position.

path_2_reposition_isolation.description: Keep the isolation mechanism but reposition it for infection control / biofilm management / maintenance — NOT ICP management.
path_2_reposition_isolation.value_proposition: Multi-segment shunt where segments can be isolated for localized treatment, biofilm control, or non-surgical replacement (if physically possible).
path_2_reposition_isolation.research_required: Build new simulator for infection/biofilm scenarios. Test whether isolation helps infection control. This is a new research direction — NOT validated.
path_2_reposition_isolation.honest_label: NEW DIRECTION. Requires fundamental rework. Not ready for buyer evaluation.

path_3_kill_P01.description: If neither path is commercially viable, P-01 enters the cemetery. The findings (reactive redundancy is harmful, isolation doesn't beat modulation) are negative results that inform future candidates.
path_3_kill_P01.honest_label: VALID OUTCOME. The cemetery is not a failure — it's negative knowledge.

decision_required: Strategic decision by CEO: Path 1, Path 2, or Path 3. This is NOT a coding decision — it's a commercial strategy decision.
